title: Information architecture is the foundation AI is starving for
description: This essay argues that poor information architecture is the root cause of AI failures like hallucinations and retrieval errors, not the AI models themselves. It's a wake-up call for organizations investing in AI without fixing their foundational data and content structure first.

title: Thinking Outside The Box: Digital Design In The AI Era
description: Rather than accepting text boxes as the default AI interface, this article explores alternative interaction paradigms for AI-powered applications. A timely read for designers rethinking how users engage with AI beyond chat.

title: How to design URLs
description: A practical guide to creating readable, maintainable URLs by correctly choosing between route paths, query parameters, and fragments—essential knowledge for modern web application design and user experience.

title: A practical guide to reducing token spend
description: Learn how to dramatically reduce AI token costs (8x improvement) and execution time (2x improvement) through workflow optimization—critical insights for product teams building with LLMs at scale.

title: Internet Service Providers UX Benchmark: 1,700+ Performance Scores and 1,100+ Best Practice Examples
description: Comprehensive UX research covering 1,700+ ISP websites with actionable best practices for complex, comparison-heavy digital products. Essential data-driven insights for improving digital service experiences.

title: I Built an MCP Server in 30 Minutes. Claude and Cursor Could Use My API Immediately.
description: A practical walkthrough of integrating an API with AI tools using Model Context Protocol, demonstrating how developer friction is disappearing between AI assistants and existing infrastructure.

title: Evaluating agents beyond the first prompt
description: This research reveals that single-turn AI agent benchmarks are misleading—regressions and error recovery matter far more than initial feature completeness for real-world reliability.

title: Capitolium: A Digital Hub for a First-of-its-Kind Sports Collaboration
description: An inspiring case study of designing a digital experience for a historic sports partnership, showcasing how thoughtful UX can bring complex, multi-brand collaborations to life.
